cases.customer_question: If new test cases are introduced in a future TCRL version, is it necessary to redo all testing or only the additional items?
cases.actual_issue: Handling additional test requirements introduced by TCRL updates and their impact on existing test reports.
cases.consultant_answer: Only the newly added test cases need to be executed. Existing test results can remain as-is, and additional tests can be provided as separate reports rather than redoing the entire test suite.
cases.final_recommendation: Perform only the incremental tests required by the new TCRL and provide them as additional reports; do not repeat unchanged testing.
